description: This Java class 'OrbitalPaymentServices' provides methods for processing various credit card transactions (authorization, capture, refund, release) through the Orbital payment gateway SDK, including request building, transaction processing, and response handling within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: OrbitalPaymentServices
classes.description: A service class for handling credit card transactions via the Orbital SDK within the OFBiz framework, including request creation, transaction processing, and response handling.

methods.name: ccAuth
methods.description: Performs an authorization-only credit card transaction through Orbital.

methods.name: ccAuthCapture
methods.description: Performs an authorization and capture transaction in a single step.

methods.name: ccCapture
methods.description: Captures a previously authorized transaction.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund to a credit card.

methods.name: ccRelease
methods.description: Reverses or releases a previously authorized transaction.

methods.name: buildOrbitalProperties
methods.description: Builds configuration properties for the Orbital SDK connection.

methods.name: getPaymentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves specific configuration values for the payment gateway from the database.

methods.name: buildAuthOrAuthCaptureTransaction
methods.description: Constructs the request for authorization or auth/capture transactions.

methods.name: buildCaptureTransaction
methods.description: Constructs the request for capturing a previously authorized transaction.

methods.name: buildRefundTransaction
methods.description: Constructs the request for refund transactions.

methods.name: buildReleaseTransaction
methods.description: Constructs the request for releasing (voiding) a transaction.

methods.name: initializeTransactionProcessor
methods.description: Initializes the TransactionProcessor instance.

methods.name: processCard
methods.description: Processes the request through the TransactionProcessor and returns the response.

methods.name: processAuthTransResult
methods.description: Handles the response for authorization transactions and updates results.

methods.name: processAuthCaptureTransResult
methods.description: Handles the response for combined auth/capture transactions.

methods.name: processCaptureTransResult
methods.description: Handles the response for capture transactions.

methods.name: processRefundTransResult
methods.description: Handles the response for refund transactions.

methods.name: processReleaseTransResult
methods.description: Handles the response for release (void) transactions.

methods.name: printTransResult
methods.description: Logs the details of the transaction response.

methods.name: formatExpDateForOrbital
methods.description: Formats expiration date for Orbital request.

methods.name: getShippingRefForOrder
methods.description: Retrieves shipping reference info for an order.

methods.name: validateRequest
methods.description: Validates the request before processing (stub implementation).
